arithmetic_gate.note: Failures are flagged, not dropped -- the same rule the extraction pipeline uses. A reconstructed numerator is marked not-verifiable rather than passing, because checking it against the percentage it came from is circular.

funnel.step: minus rows with neither a numerator nor a percentage
minus rows whose numerator exceeds its denominator

dropped_domains.Investigations / Organ nonspecific: A laboratory abnormality with no organ named. This project's `investigations` handling redistributes such findings per preferred term (investigations_rules.yaml), and that requires the term, not a domain label. The rows are retained in the raw frame with this reason so the redistribution can be applied later.
dropped_domains.Psychiatric: Outside the 14 axes. No MedDRA psychiatric SOC maps onto any axis here.
dropped_domains.Neoplasm / Disease progression: Disease progression is an outcome, not a toxicity. Counting it as an organ event would make a rapidly progressing cohort look toxic.
dropped_domains.Injury / Procedural: The same class the registry work excludes for procedural harm -- falls, contusions, fractures. See negative result 37.
dropped_domains.Unspecified site / Review needed: Their own review flag. Not assigned to an axis before a human confirms it.
dropped_domains.Hematologic / Renal (multisystem): Two rows naming two systems. Splitting them would invent a denominator and assigning both would double-count the arm.
